title: Netflix Unveils Teaser for ‘Secrets', Ravi Bharwani’s First Film in Eight Years, Premiering December 3
summary: Secrets follows Parni (Sha Ine Febriyanti), a single mother who escaped her abusive husband 16 years ago — and has spent the years since rebuilding a quiet life with her daughter
body_markdown:
Entertainment


27 October 2026


Global


Indonesia


Link copied to clipboard


Netflix has released the teaser trailer for its upcoming Indonesian film


Secrets


, marking director


Ravi Bharwani


’s return to filmmaking for the first time since his acclaimed 2018 drama


27 Steps of May


. The psychological thriller premieres globally on


December 3


and brings together two of Indonesia’s most decorated actors,


Sha Ine Febriyanti


and


Abimana Aryasatya


, sharing the screen for the first time.


Secrets


follows Parni (Sha Ine Febriyanti), a single mother who escaped her abusive husband 16 years ago — and has spent the years since rebuilding a quiet life with her daughter. All that unravels when her husband, Jamal (Abimana Aryasatya), returns, bent on revenge and threatening to expose her past. The teaser trailer offers a first glimpse of that past resurfacing, as old secrets collide with the life Parni fought to build.


Rooted in the social realities of Indonesia, the film follows a woman’s struggle for survival. Having once defied social norms to break free from abuse, she must now confront the consequences of her choices.


On


Secrets


, award-winning director Ravi Bharwani (


27 Steps of May


,


Jermal


) said: “This is my most ambitious film project to date — my first drama-thriller, my most challenging and my most complex scenes I’ve ever had to bring to life. With all those notes, I can’t wait to share it with you.”


Secrets


explores domestic violence, the world of prostitution and the universal bond between mother and child, all wrapped in mystery. Also starring


Shenina Cinnamon


and


Ruth Marini


,


Secrets


premieres globally on December 3, only on Netflix.
